# Project Context: Crypto Pasta

This workspace contains both the backend and frontend for the Crypto Pasta application.

## Repository Structure
- `./` (Root): Spring Boot backend files (controllers, services, repositories, configurations, pom.xml/build.maven).
- `./CryptoPasta-React/`: React frontend application (components, state management, UI, package.json).

## Copilot Guidelines
- Always treat backend and frontend as a unified full-stack codebase.
- When making or proposing changes to API endpoints in the Spring Boot backend, check and suggest corresponding updates in `CryptoPasta-React`.
- When updating API calls, types, or data structures in `CryptoPasta-React`, verify alignment with the Spring Boot backend models and controllers.
- Maintain full architectural awareness across both the root backend code and the nested React folder.
